cause_quote: #185730 made startup 'admit one "The Gateway restarted while you were working. Resume your work..." input' immediately, with the only re-admission in enqueueSessionEventAttempt being the config-change retainForConfigChange path, so a workspace-node NOT_CONNECTED failure settled terminally.
user_saw: After a Gateway restart mid-turn, an agent with a dedicated workspace node got a restart failure notice (node not connected) instead of resuming, and the user had to send a new message.
summary: Restart-sourced session events that fail with an undispatched workspace-node NOT_CONNECTED error are now re-admitted every second for up to 60 seconds instead of failing terminally.
reasoning: Remote/dedicated workspaces existed since September (ce616b64177, b856d4e0f4d), and the current restart-resume path that admits the resume input right at startup was introduced by 9344233e7a66 (#185730) on Oct 28 with no wait for the workspace node to reconnect, so this setup never worked on that path. I did not verify whether the retired pre-#185730 recovery machinery handled node reconnects, and the fix is partly a new retry policy, hence low confidence.
